name: Veritas
tagline: A Chrome extension that fact-checks YouTube videos as they play, with cited verdicts.

awards: Arista Networks: Connect the Dots Challenge

problem: Misinformation spreads fastest through video and viewers cannot check claims in real time.
solution: Streams captions to a backend where Gemma extracts claims; a Fetch.ai agent checks a semantic cache, gathers evidence from Wikipedia and fact-check databases and returns a verdict with confidence and citations.
demo_moment: Team-described: play a video and see claims flagged true, false or misleading beside it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Arista Networks: Connect the Dots Challenge” among 307 submissions.

lessons: Fact-checking is only trusted when the sources are on screen.
